evals.prompt: Explain what a race condition is in a program, and give one standard way to prevent it.
evals.expected_output: A terse, accurate chat reply in robot style: starts with `... `, no filler or pleasantries, well under 50 words, and still defines the concept and names a real fix.
expectations: The reply begins with literal `... ` (three dots and a space).
The reply is terse: at most 50 words.
The reply contains no filler or pleasantry words (sure, certainly, of course, just, really, basically, actually, happy to, great question).
The reply is accurate: it ties race conditions to concurrent/shared state and names a synchronization fix (lock, mutex, atomic, semaphore, transaction).
